# V1.8.8

Section: Source

**V1.8.8** of *[Stormworks: Build and Rescue](https://stormworks.fandom.com/wiki/Stormworks:_Build_and_Rescue)* was released on September 1st, 2023.

## V1.8.8

- Fix - [#19773](https://geometa.co.uk/support/stormworks/19773) Steam Deck crashing on launch
- Fix - [#19460](https://geometa.co.uk/support/stormworks/19460) Updated Zizo workbench interactable
- Fix - [#19951](https://geometa.co.uk/support/stormworks/19951) Fire extinguisher particles now respect velocity
- Fix - [#17902](https://geometa.co.uk/support/stormworks/17902) Updated Bertha cannon voxels
- Fix - [#20287](https://geometa.co.uk/support/stormworks/20287) Added ladder to archtech survey base
- Fix - [#20392](https://geometa.co.uk/support/stormworks/20392) Triangle errors on arid isles 18_10
- Fix - [#20363](https://geometa.co.uk/support/stormworks/20363) Several sign positions on Arid isles
- Fix - [#20544](https://geometa.co.uk/support/stormworks/20544) Removed physics from FJWarner dock pads
- Fix - [#20012](https://geometa.co.uk/support/stormworks/20012) Spelling error
